title: Women's Safety
summary: Support and official channels for women facing harassment, violence or abuse.
whatToDoNow: If you are in immediate physical danger, call 112.
Move to a public or well-lit place and tell someone you trust where you are.
Call 181 for support, guidance and referrals.
Note the date, time, place and what happened as soon as you safely can.
whoToContact: 15100, National Legal Aid Helpline, for free legal advice
whereToReport: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) for online harassment
Nearest police station, to file a complaint
whatInformationToKeep: Dates, times and locations of each incident
Names or descriptions of everyone involved, including witnesses
Exact wording of threatening or harassing messages
Any earlier complaints and their outcome
whatEvidenceToPreserve: Screenshots of messages, calls or social media activity
Voice notes or recordings where legally permissible
Medical records if there was any physical harm
